caption: The drawing is done in pencil on a light, uncolored background and features several distinct objects arranged on the page. The central object is a detailed rendering of a large, curved metal rake with evenly spaced, downward-facing tines and a handle extending upward from the center of the top edge. In the upper left corner, inside a rectangular frame, there is a simple, shaded outline of a hard shell clam labeled “HARD SHELL CLAM.” In the lower left corner, another rectangular frame encloses a similarly shaded outline of an oyster shell, labeled “OYSTER.” In the upper right corner, a rectangular box contains a small, shaded ring labeled “RZ,” a cylindrical shape labeled “POLE 1 1/8" x 2 1/4",” and an elongated object with a pointed end, labeled “STEEL KEY.” The entire composition is executed in shades of grey, with the objects outlined and shaded to indicate dimension and texture, and the artist's signature “WM. MILLS” appears in the lower right region of the main central box.
title: Clam Rake
